work_identified: Collection of astronomical and astrological texts by Abraham ibn Ezra (Hebrew) — identity unresolved; cataloger's generic title for a compiled manuscript or printed collection. Likely contains some or all of ibn Ezra's astrological corpus (Reshit Hokhmah, Sefer ha-Te'amim, Sefer ha-Olam, Sefer ha-Moladot, Sefer ha-She'elot, Sefer ha-Mivharim, Sefer ha-Me'orot, Mishpetei ha-Mazzalot) and possibly distinct astronomical works (Keli ha-Nehoshet, astronomical tables, Sefer ha-ibbur).
